The 4 Canonical Conceptual Flows: Experience, Value Stream, Domain Data & Enterprise Integration

User Journey Flow (Experience Flow)
Persona interaction & clinical objective definition without infrastructure mechanics
Chemists and biologists engage via Discovery Studio to configure kinase targets, set selectivity profiles, review generated leads, and grant 21 CFR Part 11 sign-off.

Business Process Flow (Value Stream)
Target-to-lead milestone progression & autonomous capability coordination
Orchestrates sequential value stream: Target Identification → Cryptic Pocket Discovery → De Novo Generative Chemistry → ADMET Screening → Wet-Lab Workcell.

Domain Data Flow
Macroscopic information movement across bounded biomedical contexts
Traces information transformation: Target Genomics Dossier → Molecular Knowledge Graph → 3D Protein Structures → Candidate SMILES → In Vitro Readouts.

Enterprise Integration Flow
Coarse-grained boundary handoffs to external registries & laboratory robotics
Standards-based interoperability: Agent-to-Agent (A2A), MCP tool servers, UniProt/PDB external repositories, and SiLA 2 standard for liquid handler execution.
